reasoning: Multiple contradictions: (1) By Ramsey R(4,3)=9, on 10 vertices we cannot have both max clique ≤ 3 and max independent set ≤ 2. (2) "Exactly 1 vertex-disjoint K_4 covering all vertices" is impossible since 1·4 ≠ 10. (3) A single K_4 has only 6 edges, not 15-18, and contains a clique of size 4 violating max clique ≤ 3.
